mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4 and has antiplatelet properties, potentially increasing fenofibrate levels and bleeding risk, while both agents may have additive effects on lipid metabolism and platelet function.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding and myalgia; consider INR monitoring if patient on anticoagulants; counsel on turmeric dose limitations and report unusual bruising or muscle pain.
